name: cnki-scholar
description: Search CNKI literature metadata, inspect paper records, and trace reference lists with a read-only MCP server and research skill.

interface.shortDescription: Search and inspect CNKI literature metadata.
interface.longDescription: Find Chinese academic literature on CNKI, narrow by year and document type, inspect bibliographic metadata, and follow reference lists. Designed for read-only literature discovery and novelty checks.
defaultPrompt: Search CNKI for recent literature on my research topic and group the most relevant journal articles and theses.
Check whether this proposed research title has already been studied on CNKI, using both exact-title and broader topic searches.
Find the most cited CNKI papers on this topic, then inspect the strongest matches and their references.
